name: automattic/shareadraft
description: Share a Draft plugin for sharing draft content with external stakeholders.

scripts-descriptions.behat: Run the WP-CLI Behat feature tests (needs a running wp-env; see prepare-behat-tests)
scripts-descriptions.behat-rerun: Rerun only the Behat scenarios that failed last time
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Run PHPStan static analysis (level 10, with the WordPress, strict-rules, PHPUnit and dead-code extensions)
scripts-descriptions.prepare-behat-tests: Start the wp-env environment the Behat tests run against
scripts-descriptions.i18n: Regenerate the POT file and any JSON catalogues (needs WP-CLI and a current `npm run build`)
scripts-descriptions.i18n:json: Split translated PO files into the JSON catalogues the editor script loads
scripts-descriptions.i18n:pot: Regenerate languages/shareadraft.pot from the PHP and the built editor script
scripts-descriptions.test: Run PHPUnit (unit + integration) and Playwright e2e tests (e2e needs a running vip dev-env)
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Run Playwright e2e tests only (needs a running vip dev-env)
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration suite (boots a real WordPress test environment)
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the fast unit suite (pure PHP, no WordPress)
